ViGALT_ablation.alt_text: The chair has a high, rounded back and integrated curved arms, featuring vertical channel stitching and a separate rectangular seat cushion. It is upholstered in white and has a separate rectangular white cushion placed against the backrest; it rests on a white five-spoke wheeled base with black-and-white casters and a black adjustment lever extending beneath the seat on the left side. A desk and laptop are positioned behind it.
